name: Seafood Gastro

menus.name: Signature Menu
menus.note: Wednesday to Saturday evenings and Friday lunch. Wine pairing SEK 2,200, premium SEK 4,290, alcohol-free SEK 1,100, mixed SEK 1,600. Can't be made without fish, seafood or milk protein.

menus.name: Menu Selection
menus.note: A shorter version of the Signature Menu. Wednesday and Thursday evenings and Friday lunch. Wine pairing SEK 1,400, premium SEK 2,990, alcohol-free SEK 700, mixed SEK 1,000.

alsoTry.name: Matbaren
alsoTry.note: Mathias Dahlgren's food bar in the same hotel, serving medium-sized seasonal dishes; lunch Wednesday to Friday, dinner Monday to Saturday.

bookingOpens: Online through the booking button on the restaurant's website, or by email or phone. Tables are released a couple of months at a time: in October 2026 bookings were open for October and November.

bookingWindow.note: Released a couple of months at a time; in October 2026 bookings were open for October and November.

groups: Two private dining rooms for 14 and 10 guests, which can be combined for up to 24, with seasonal set menus or a menu planned with the team; ask by email at reservations@mdghs.com.
duration: About four hours for the Signature Menu, and about two hours for Menu Selection.
